title: The Asteroid That Killed the Dinosaurs Hit at 25 km a Second

scenes.text: The asteroid that killed the dinosaurs hit Earth at 25 kilometres a second.
It was more than ten kilometres wide, bigger than Mount Everest is tall.
Researchers at the University of Texas estimate the blast equalled ten billion atomic bombs.
It carved a crater about 200 kilometres across, in what is now Mexico.
Sixty-six million years later, the scar is still there, buried under Mexico.

description:
The Chicxulub asteroid was over 10 km wide and struck at more than 25 km a second.
NASA describes the impact crater as about 200 km across, and University of Texas researchers estimated the energy at about ten billion World War Two atomic bombs.
What would you have done 66 million years ago? Comment below.
first_comment: The crater is buried under Mexico's Yucatan today. Would you want to see it if you could?
